item.title: Whiskers 0.8.24
item.description:
What's New in 0.8.24

### More Cloud Transcription Choices

  • Added OpenAI as a first-class cloud transcription provider with automatic model discovery, smarter failover, and safer startup behavior.
  • Introduced Google Gemini cloud transcription plus an auto-cleanup prompt so transcripts come back normalized and readable.
  • Refreshed the transcription model menus: providers are grouped, cloud models are easy to pick, and choices persist reliably.

    • ### Bulk Transcription Polish

  • File cards now surface transcript previews, tighter prompts, and clearer modals so you can scan results faster.
  • Prompt chips and layout tweaks make bulk runs feel lighter and more consistent.

    • ### Settings & Menu Enhancements

  • Settings pages now share unified headers, cards, and spacing for a cleaner, predictable experience.
  • AI Enhancement settings keep prompt drafts when you switch providers and use a dedicated editor session for stability.
  • Groq is now the default AI enhancement provider out of the box.
  • New menu bar options: toggle “Start Whiskers at Login” and choose cloud models directly from the status item, with a subtler icon tint.

    • ### Reliability Fixes

  • AI Enhancement guardrails normalize model outputs and handle mixed content arrays to prevent malformed results.
  • Cloud transcription registry and fallback handling are sturdier, reducing startup and routing hiccups.
